sources.title: GitHub - CraftsMan-Labs/SLM-RL
sources.snippet: SLM-RL A self-improving game gymnasium for small language models. Small language models learn to play games through reinforcement learning: the model plays games in text-native environments, every decision is collected into a reusable dataset, the model is automatically fine-tuned on its own experience, and the improved model re-enters play.
